register_attention_backend: register an attention backend handler function in the AttentionBackendRegistry by backend name
get_attention_handler: get the registered attention handler function for a given backend name from AttentionBackendRegistry
handle_flashinfer_attention: handle flashinfer attention backend routing to select the appropriate forward method for DeepSeek models
handle_triton_attention: handle triton attention backend routing to select the appropriate forward method for DeepSeek models
handle_ascend_attention: handle ascend NPU attention backend routing to select DSA or MHA forward method for DeepSeek models
